2. Invalid client password fails authentication
11. Expired Sanctum bearer token is rejected with 401 Unauthorized
23. 2FA TOTP verification rejects invalid OTP code
19. Inertia request to protected route returns 409 with X-Inertia-Location on unauthenticated access
6. Invalid admin password is rejected
12. Sanctum token ability validation helper functions properly
14. User cannot access another workspace to which they do not belong (IDOR Protection)
1. Valid client login succeeds and returns Inertia 303 redirect to dashboard
13. Workspace membership validation succeeds for user's own workspace
20. Inertia request returns 403 Forbidden JSON on unauthorized access
3. Unknown client user fails authentication
18. Session expiration rejects unauthenticated access
5. Valid admin login succeeds and redirects to admin dashboard
21. Spring Security verifies existing Laravel BCrypt password hashes without modifying them
8. Admin session cannot automatically access client user routes without client credentials
17. Logout invalidates session and clears SecurityContext
15. CSRF validation succeeds with valid CSRF token
